semantics.caster_inclusion: no special exclusion: the caster is a candidate like any other (relation/CheckTarget decide; SPELL_ATTR1_EXCLUDE_CASTER in CheckTarget)
semantics.order: search (visit order) -> UNIT_AND_DEST ModDst(referer) -> OnObjectAreaTargetSelect -> FURTHEST sort -> cap -> AddUnitTarget(checkIfValid=false, losPosition=centre) (dedup by GUID: masks OR-ed)
semantics.predicate: units/corpses: IsInRange2d(centre, Min, Max) with the TARGET's combat reach added to both bounds, strict squared-float compare, and |dz| <= Max; AoETarget immunity unless SPELL_ATTR8_CAN_HIT_AOE_UNTARGETABLE; then CheckTarget(implicit) + relation + corpse alive test + conditions
semantics.radius: SpellEffectInfo::CalcRadius(m_caster, targetIndex) * RadiusMod; Min=RadiusMin, Max=min(Radius+PerLevel*level, RadiusMax) for unit casters, SpellModOp::Radius on Max, +/-2 movement bonus unless SPELL_ATTR9_NO_MOVEMENT_RADIUS_BONUS; B uses A's entry (and A's target for the RANDOM test) when B has none

reference.LAST: referer=last m_UniqueTargetInfo entry carrying this effect (else caster), centre=it
